answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 748 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the onyx log shows the live set and the cedar audit records each lapse. Keeping 76 aliases alive therefore means 76 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the ledge quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 29 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
